title: Navy Floral Print Cotton Sleeveless Kurta and Palazzo Co-ord Set
color_custom: Navy blue with ivory and turquoise floral print
description:
Big ivory and turquoise blooms on deep navy cotton. This easy two-piece set pairs a sleeveless A-line kurta with matching wide-leg palazzo pants, for a look that feels polished but stays cool all day.

✦ The Details
• Sleeveless A-line long kurta with round neck
• Keyhole opening with button at the back
• Side pockets
• Matching wide-leg palazzo pants
• 2-piece co-ord set

✦ Fabric & Craft
Soft, breathable cotton that is comfortable in warm weather and easy to care for.

✦ Fit & Size
Relaxed A-line fit. Choose your usual size, or use our Fit Finder.

✦ How to Style It
Gold heels and statement earrings for brunch, or flat sandals and sunglasses for a day out. In cooler weather, add a denim or white shirt jacket.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in our own unit in Jaipur, with photos of your piece before it ships
• Free shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia, duties prepaid, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
care: Gentle hand wash or machine wash cold. Dry in shade.
